correctness.rationale: For the projective design A A^T=(k-lambda_design)I+lambda_design J and t=sqrt(k-lambda_design). Distance categories are 2 within class, 1 incident, 3 nonincident. Orthogonal block decomposition yields exact branches g_+(p)=-2^p+t(3^p-1), g_-(p)=-2^p-t(3^p-1), each mult v-1, and contrast h(p)=(v-1)2^p-(v-k)3^p-k, mult1. g_-<0; g_+ crosses once. At its root s, algebraic comparison of h(s) reduces to x=2^s versus 1+(q-1)/(q(t-1)); Bernoulli bounds and separate exact binary d=2,3,4,5 cases fix the sign. In q=2,d>=5 the strictly concave contrast divided by 2^p crosses first; in remaining cases singular branch first. Schoenberg and strictly injective Euclidean distance embeddings imply Gaussian kernel positive definite for u>0 and admitted p, endpoint nullity and minimal embedding dimension. Independent 15 parameter cases q=2,3,4; d=2..6 reproduce branch phase, signs and thresholds, including q2 d4 about 0.3358378 and d5 about 0.1403684. Finite cases cannot establish arbitrary prime powers; the design-spectral proof does.
residual_risks: The tests are finite and do not replace the all-parameter proof.
